description: This file contains the AppIdentityDbContextSeed class with a static method to seed initial data into the identity database, including creating roles and default users.

classes.name: AppIdentityDbContextSeed
classes.description: A utility class for seeding initial identity data such as roles and default users into the database.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds the identity database with default roles and users, and applies database migrations if using SQL Server.
